== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face says “If you control” on the Light Side and “If you have Vader or Emperor” on the Dark Side. The January 2013 PC sheet, 2023 Appendix A and complete errata faces remove both qualifications. The physical Revised and Reflections II foil faces also omit the control phrase, but specifically print “Emperor Palpatine.” Those are separate publications in Versions. The pinned PC Dark.json record 910 preserves the earlier Limited wording. The errata text follows the rulebooks and matching face.
